_comment: Art direction for pre-generated card art. build_prompts.py combines this with the game content into prompts.json. Edit freely: subject descriptions keep each athlete/character looking the same across every card they appear on. Every subject is fictional; never add real people, teams, leagues or brand logos.

global.prefix: Trading card artwork, portrait orientation, single original fictional subject, full-bleed illustration with no border.
global.composition: Subject framed in the upper two thirds of the image; keep the bottom quarter darker and less busy for a name plate; keep the top corners clear for badges.
global.suffix: Highly detailed, crisp focus on the subject, professional collectible card quality.
global.negative: text, letters, words, numbers, watermark, signature, logo, trademark, card border, frame, caption, jersey lettering, real person likeness, celebrity, blurry, deformed hands, extra limbs, cropped head, duplicate subject
shots: Three-quarter close-up portrait with an action background.
global.setSuffix: Highly detailed, wide establishing shot, professional key art quality.

fh26.style: Modern basketball card photo-illustration, dynamic indoor arena lighting, shallow depth of field, clean vibrant color grading, 2020s sports card look.
fh26.setArt: A packed modern basketball arena from courtside under bright lights, empty glossy court in the foreground, wide cinematic view.

fhr26.style: Modern basketball rookie card photo-illustration, warm spotlight, hopeful energy, soft bokeh crowd behind, 2020s sports card look.
fhr26.setArt: A spotlit basketball court tunnel entrance with a fresh hardwood floor and confetti in the air, wide cinematic view.

apex26.style: Premium baseball card art with a chrome refractor aesthetic, dramatic night stadium lighting, strong rim light, rich saturated color, high-end sports card look.
apex26.setArt: A night baseball stadium seen from behind home plate, glowing floodlights, a pristine diamond, wide cinematic view.

hl94.style: 1990s baseball card, painted portrait over a photo, slightly faded print colors, soft film grain, sunny daytime ballpark, nostalgic vintage cardboard look.
hl94.setArt: A sunny 1990s ballpark with a hand-painted outfield wall and old wooden bleachers, faded film photograph look, wide view.

aeth.style: Epic fantasy trading card game illustration, painterly digital art, luminous magical lighting, floating islands and storm clouds in the background.
aeth.setArt: The floating isles of a fantasy sky realm at sunset, waterfalls spilling into clouds, a distant storm dragon silhouette, wide painterly panorama.

mfo01.style: Early-2000s fantasy trading card game art, traditional gouache and airbrush painting, slightly dated vintage palette, classic high-fantasy look.
mfo01.setArt: A classic painted fantasy landscape of a castle on a floating rock above the clouds, vintage 2000s gouache style, wide panorama.

nova.style: Space opera trading card game illustration, cinematic sci-fi concept art, neon rim lighting, starfields and nebulae in the background.
nova.setArt: A frontier space station orbiting a ringed planet inside a colorful nebula, starships docking, wide cinematic panorama.

modifiers.alternateArt: Alternate art: a dramatic full-scene composition with a different pose and setting from the regular card, extra-vivid color.

rarity.Legendary: Legendary aura, god rays and particles, the most dramatic version of the subject.

variants._comment: Optional unique art for 1/1 parallels, saved as {artKey}_{parallelId}. Build them with build_prompts.py --variants. Cards without variant art fall back to the base art.
variants.black1: Monochrome black-and-gold version of the scene, deep shadows, gold highlights.
variants.superfractor1: Iridescent gold superfractor version of the scene, swirling rainbow light refractions.
variants.mythic1: Mythic version of the scene, the subject surrounded by a cosmic violet aura and constellations.
